# Generated by gen_theme_setup.py; edit the generator and regenerate instead of editing by hand.

oe_theme_found_all_action = { # 一键设立军区
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes } }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            has_raised_levies = no
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_theme_found_all_none_tt oe_theme_any_creatable = yes }
        }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
            custom_tooltip = { text = OE_PILLARS_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED_5 var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes } }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = oe_theme_found_all_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_found_all_count value = 0 }
                oe_theme_found_all = { cost = 5 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_setup.2
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_theme_move_seat_action = { # 迁移军区治所
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes } }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { at_war = no }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
            custom_tooltip = { text = OE_PILLARS_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED_5 var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes } }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        target_flag = target_country
        name = "oe_theme_move_seat_select"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_byz_selcet_bank_country_non"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
            has_variable = oe_theme_region_id
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_seat_moved_cd }
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = location
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = {
                every_owned_location = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
                    add_to_list = source
                }
            }
        }
        target_flag = target_location
        name = "choose_location"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_theme_move_seat_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { oe_theme_seat_candidate = yes }
    }
    effect = {
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -5 } }
        custom_tooltip = oe_theme_move_seat_tt
        # The effect is also evaluated for the tooltip before a theme and a location are chosen.
        hidden_effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:target_country exists = scope:target_location scope:target_country = { exists = capital } }
                scope:target_country = { save_scope_as = oe_ms_theme capital = { save_scope_as = oe_ms_old } }
                scope:target_location = { save_scope_as = oe_ms_new }
                oe_theme_move_seat = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
